title: Koszul modules, holonomy Lie algebras, and resonance of groups and CDGAs
summary: We develop a Koszul-theoretic framework for comparing classical Alexander-type invariants with infinitesimal invariants arising from finite-type commutative differential graded algebra models. The central mechanism is Koszul linearization, which replaces nonlinear equivariant constructions with functorial algebraic objects defined from a CDGA. To a connected CDGA $(A,d)$ with finite-dimensional $H^1(A)$ we associate Koszul modules $\mathcal{B}_i(A)$ over the symmetric algebra on $H_1(A)$.
